rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for physical proximity to a place or thing.

example.english: This convenience store is very near the MTR station.
example.traditional: 呢間便利店好近地鐵站。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 bin6 lei6 dim3 hou2 kan5 dei6 tit3 zaam6

rows.note: Use 近 as the all-purpose choice for physical closeness, and in established expressions such as 近義詞 for approximate lexical similarity.

example.english: This convenience store is very near my home.
example.traditional: 呢間便利店好近我屋企。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 bin6 lei6 dim3 hou2 gan6 ngo5 uk1 kei2

rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for “nearly” or “almost,” including “almost unconscious.”

example.jyutping: ngo5 caa1 m4 do1 wan4 dai1 laa3

rows.note: Use this when “nearly” means that something is imminent or will happen soon.

example.jyutping: sei2 sin3 zau6 faai3 dou3 laa3

rows.note: Use this for being close in space or time, such as being near a place or a deadline.

example.english: This place is near the MTR station.
example.jyutping: ni1 dou6 gan6 dei6 tit3 zaam6

rows.note: Use this for moving closer or coming near, especially in commands and directional expressions.

example.jyutping: nei5 haang4 maai4 lei4 di1 sin1

rows.note: Use 差唔多 for approximate amounts or times and for saying that something is almost finished or almost identical.

example.jyutping: ji4 gaa1 caa1 m4 do1 saam1 dim2 laa3

rows.note: Use this when an event or action is imminent or almost finished, as in near completion.

example.english: The homework is near to being finished.
example.jyutping: fan6 gung1 fo3 zau6 faai3 zou6 jyun4 laa3

rows.note: Use 就快 + V when an event or time point is approaching, as in 就快完 for “the end is near.”

example.english: The meeting is near its end.
example.jyutping: go3 wui6 ji5 zau6 faai3 jyun4 laa3

rows.note: Use this before an abstract endpoint or standard when the closeness is a matter of degree.

example.english: This score is already near the passing mark.
example.traditional: 呢個成績已經接近合格線喇。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 sing4 zik1 ji5 ging1 zip3 gan6 hap6 gaak3 sin3 laa3

rows.note: Use 近親 specifically for close relatives rather than for a general close relationship.

example.english: She is a near relative of mine.
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai6 ngo5 ge3 gan6 can1
